name: Tirnach Vault 135 EGEO
description: Key Features Deep Storage Chamber: 8-metre chamber depth provides substantial vertical storage space, ideal for maximizing dairy product capacity in limited floor areas. Eutectic-Buffered Cooling: Maintains a stable, ultra-low holding temperature of -20°C, ensuring optimal preservation and freshness of sensitive dairy goods. High Storage Capacity: Accommodates up to 860 units, supporting both small-scale and large-scale storage needs for dairy producers, distributors, or retailers. Efficient Retrieval System: Average retrieval time of 24 minutes allows for timely and organized access to stored products. Flexible Access Period: Available for use over a 4-month open period, suitable for seasonal storage or short-term inventory management. Transparent Pricing: Annual fee is determined post-acceptance, providing clarity and flexibility based on specific storage requirements. Main Benefits Enhanced Product Preservation: The consistent -20°C eutectic-buffered environment protects dairy items from spoilage and maintains quality during long-term storage. Optimized Storage Utilization: The deep chamber and large unit capacity help businesses efficiently manage inventory and reduce the need for multiple storage locations. Reliable Access: Predictable retrieval times streamline logistics and reduce delays in product distribution or restocking. Adaptable Usage: The 4-month access window is ideal for businesses with seasonal inventory cycles or fluctuating storage demands. Budget-Friendly Options: Post-acceptance fee structure ensures you only pay for what you need, supporting cost-effective storage planning. Typical Use Cases or Outcomes Seasonal Dairy Inventory Storage: Perfect for dairies or distributors needing secure, climate-controlled storage during peak production months. Cold Chain Management: Supports businesses seeking to maintain strict temperature control for perishable dairy products, such as cheese, milk, or yogurt. Short-Term Warehousing: Useful for retailers or producers requiring temporary storage before product launch or market distribution. Inventory Overflow Solution: Acts as a backup storage facility during periods of high demand or unexpected inventory surges. Frequently Addressed User Needs Is the unit suitable for long-term dairy storage? Yes, the -20°C eutectic-buffered system ensures safe, extended preservation. How much can I store? Up to 860 units, making it suitable for various business sizes. How quickly can I retrieve my products? Standard retrieval time is 24 minutes, supporting efficient operations. Is the storage period flexible? The cellar is available for a continuous 4-month period, ideal for planned or seasonal storage requirements. How is pricing determined? The annual fee is set after acceptance, allowing for tailored pricing based on your specific needs.
description_html:
Key Features

  • Deep Storage Chamber: 8-metre chamber depth provides substantial vertical storage space, ideal for maximizing dairy product capacity in limited floor areas.
  • Eutectic-Buffered Cooling: Maintains a stable, ultra-low holding temperature of -20°C, ensuring optimal preservation and freshness of sensitive dairy goods.
  • High Storage Capacity: Accommodates up to 860 units, supporting both small-scale and large-scale storage needs for dairy producers, distributors, or retailers.
  • Efficient Retrieval System: Average retrieval time of 24 minutes allows for timely and organized access to stored products.
  • Flexible Access Period: Available for use over a 4-month open period, suitable for seasonal storage or short-term inventory management.
  • Transparent Pricing: Annual fee is determined post-acceptance, providing clarity and flexibility based on specific storage requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Enhanced Product Preservation: The consistent -20°C eutectic-buffered environment protects dairy items from spoilage and maintains quality during long-term storage.
  • Optimized Storage Utilization: The deep chamber and large unit capacity help businesses efficiently manage inventory and reduce the need for multiple storage locations.
  • Reliable Access: Predictable retrieval times streamline logistics and reduce delays in product distribution or restocking.
  • Adaptable Usage: The 4-month access window is ideal for businesses with seasonal inventory cycles or fluctuating storage demands.
  • Budget-Friendly Options: Post-acceptance fee structure ensures you only pay for what you need, supporting cost-effective storage planning.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Seasonal Dairy Inventory Storage: Perfect for dairies or distributors needing secure, climate-controlled storage during peak production months.
  • Cold Chain Management: Supports businesses seeking to maintain strict temperature control for perishable dairy products, such as cheese, milk, or yogurt.
  • Short-Term Warehousing: Useful for retailers or producers requiring temporary storage before product launch or market distribution.
  • Inventory Overflow Solution: Acts as a backup storage facility during periods of high demand or unexpected inventory surges.

Frequently Addressed User Needs

  • Is the unit suitable for long-term dairy storage? Yes, the -20°C eutectic-buffered system ensures safe, extended preservation.
  • How much can I store? Up to 860 units, making it suitable for various business sizes.
  • How quickly can I retrieve my products? Standard retrieval time is 24 minutes, supporting efficient operations.
  • Is the storage period flexible? The cellar is available for a continuous 4-month period, ideal for planned or seasonal storage requirements.
  • How is pricing determined? The annual fee is set after acceptance, allowing for tailored pricing based on your specific needs.
